products.name: Descript Overdub
products.note: Voice cloning for editing; consent recording required; deepfake risk; media integrity

profile_text.body:
Descript is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company describes itself as an AI video and audio editor built around a text-based editing model: users record or upload footage, Descript transcribes it automatically, and edits to the transcript, such as deleting a word or moving a sentence, apply directly to the corresponding video or audio. The tool supports recording, transcribing, editing, and publishing within a single workflow.

Descript's main product is its eponymous editor, tracked in the video generation and editing category, and it includes a feature called Overdub, a voice cloning tool that requires consent recording and carries noted considerations around deepfake risk and media integrity. The site also describes an AI sub-feature called Underlord, presented as an automated co-editor that can take a raw recording and produce a trimmed cut without manual intervention. The company additionally offers clip creation from longer-form video or podcast content.

The held facts record no litigation and no MCP server presence for Descript.
